status_note: Three bounded Wave E families are VALIDATED in the formal official-CGAL 6.2.1 worker and the MCP auto/legacy publication paths, each with a mandatory independent validator: Mesh_2 (refine_Delaunay_mesh_2 over a polygon-with-holes domain) Surface_mesher (make_surface_mesh over the enumerated typed implicit domains sphere, ellipsoid and torus; Surface_mesher is a deprecated CGAL package; no free-form expressions) and Mesh_3 (make_mesh_3 over the same enumerated domains with typed facet and cell criteria; perturbation and exudation disabled). They were verified by the repository's own cases and MCP end-to-end tests and have not had a separate independent native review. Mesh_2 conforming-only, Lipschitz/local sizing criteria, Lloyd optimization, Mesh_3 polyhedral/image domains, perturbation, exudation, Lloyd/ODT optimization and sharp-feature protection, the separate Mesh_3 domain criteria requirement, further implicit domains, image/polyhedral domains and sharp-feature surface meshing remain unimplemented.

operations.summary: Refine a polygon-with-holes domain into a constrained Delaunay triangle mesh meeting a shape (aspect) bound and a maximum edge length with refine_Delaunay_mesh_2.
aliases: ドロネー細分メッシュ
平面三角形メッシュ生成

aspect_bound.description: Squared sine of the minimum triangle angle (Delaunay_mesh_size_criteria_2 aspect bound); 0.125 is about 20.7 degrees and is the Mesh_2 termination guarantee.

size_bound.description: Upper bound on the longest triangle edge (Delaunay_mesh_size_criteria_2 size bound).

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic

operations.summary: Independent exact check that a Triangulation2 is a conforming, constrained Delaunay mesh of the polygon-with-holes domain meeting the aspect and size criteria.

aspect_bound.description: Squared sine of the minimum angle the validator enforces.

output_contract.independence: validator does not call CGAL Mesh_2 (refine_Delaunay_mesh_2) or any mesher under test

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic

operations.summary: Generate a closed, outward-oriented triangle surface mesh of a typed implicit domain (sphere, ellipsoid or torus; a fixed enumerated set, no free-form expressions) with CGAL Surface_mesher make_surface_mesh under angle, size (surface Delaunay ball radius) and distance criteria. Surface_mesher is a deprecated CGAL 6.2.1 package.
aliases: 陰関数曲面のメッシュ化
トーラスメッシュ生成

angle_bound.description: Lower bound in degrees for the facet angles (Surface_mesh_default_criteria_3 angular bound); 30 degrees is the Surface_mesher termination guarantee.

size_bound.description: Upper bound on the radius of the surface Delaunay balls (size / radius bound).

distance_bound.description: Upper bound on the distance between a facet circumcentre and the centre of its surface Delaunay ball; must not exceed 0.1 times the smallest curvature radius of the domain.

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic

operations.summary: Independent check that a TriangleSurfaceMesh is a closed, connected, consistently outward-oriented 2-manifold of the typed implicit domain: vertices on the analytic surface, genus by Euler characteristic, angle, size and distance criteria, sampled distance bound, and analytic area and volume. It never calls Surface_mesher or Mesh_3.

angle_bound.description: Smallest facet angle in degrees the validator enforces.

size_bound.description: Largest facet circumradius (a necessary consequence of the surface Delaunay ball radius bound) the validator enforces.

distance_bound.description: Largest distance of a facet circumcentre from the analytic surface the validator enforces.

output_contract.independence: validator does not call CGAL Surface_mesher (make_surface_mesh), Mesh_3 or the implicit-surface oracle under test

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic

operations.summary: Independent check that a TetrahedralMesh (vertices, tetrahedra, per-cell subdomain index) is a valid volume mesh: distinct and used vertices, exactly oriented non-degenerate tetrahedra, face adjacency with every interior face shared by exactly two opposite-facing cells, a single closed boundary surface, 3-manifold vertex links, face connectivity, cell-sum versus boundary-divergence volume, an optional declared domain volume, and dihedral-angle / radius-edge statistics with optional bounds. It never calls Mesh_3.

domain_volume.description: Declared domain volume in the candidate unit cubed; when given the total tetrahedron volume must match it.

volume_relative_tolerance.description: Relative tolerance for domain_volume (default 1e-6); only valid together with domain_volume.

minimum_dihedral_angle.description: Smallest dihedral angle in degrees every tetrahedron must satisfy.

maximum_radius_edge_ratio.description: Largest circumradius to shortest-edge ratio every tetrahedron may have (regular tetrahedron: 0.6124).

minimum_tetrahedron_volume.description: Smallest tetrahedron volume in the candidate unit cubed.

output_contract.independence: validator does not call CGAL Mesh_3 (make_mesh_3) or any mesher; it uses only the exact orientation predicate and its own combinatorics and arithmetic

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact orientation predicate on binary64 vertices; volumes, angles and radius-edge ratios use binary64 arithmetic with long double volume accumulation

operations.summary: Generate a tetrahedral volume mesh (TetrahedralMesh, one subdomain) of a typed implicit domain (sphere, ellipsoid or torus; a fixed enumerated set, no free-form expressions) with CGAL Mesh_3 make_mesh_3 over a Labeled_mesh_domain_3 under typed facet angle/size/distance and cell radius-edge/size criteria. Perturbation and exudation are disabled; closed surface polyhedra, images and sharp features are unsupported.
aliases: トーラス体積メッシュ

facet_angle.description: Lower bound in degrees for the angles of the boundary facets (Mesh_3 facet_angle); 30 degrees is the termination guarantee.

facet_size.description: Upper bound on the radius of the surface Delaunay balls of the boundary facets (Mesh_3 facet_size).

facet_distance.description: Upper bound on the distance between a boundary facet circumcentre and the centre of its surface Delaunay ball (Mesh_3 facet_distance); must not exceed 0.1 times the smallest curvature radius of the domain.

cell_radius_edge_ratio.description: Upper bound on the circumradius to shortest-edge ratio of every cell (Mesh_3 cell_radius_edge_ratio); at least 2, the termination guarantee.

cell_size.description: Upper bound on the circumradius of every cell (Mesh_3 cell_size).

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic

operations.summary: Independent check that a TetrahedralMesh is a valid volume mesh of a typed implicit domain: the full tetrahedral mesh validation (exact orientation, face adjacency, single closed boundary, 3-manifold vertex links, cell-versus-boundary volume), one subdomain, vertices inside the domain and boundary vertices on the analytic surface, outward boundary, boundary and solid Euler characteristics, the facet angle/size/distance and cell size/radius-edge criteria recomputed from the raw mesh, and the analytic volume and boundary area. It never calls Mesh_3.

facet_angle.description: Smallest angle in degrees every boundary facet must have.

facet_size.description: Largest circumradius every boundary facet may have.

facet_distance.description: Largest distance between a boundary facet circumcentre and the analytic surface.

cell_radius_edge_ratio.description: Largest circumradius to shortest-edge ratio every cell may have (regular tetrahedron: 0.6124).

cell_size.description: Largest circumradius every cell may have.

output_contract.independence: validator does not call CGAL Mesh_3 (make_mesh_3) or any mesher; it uses only the exact orientation predicate and its own combinatorics and arithmetic

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic
